rows.text: Allotment Of 78,11,100 Fully Convertible Equity Warrants On A Preferential Basis.

allots **98,38,200 fully convertible warrants at Rs 12 to two allottees, Vandanaben Patel of the promoter group and public shareholder Sureshkumar Patel**, in a first tranche with 25% received upfront and no change yet in paid-up capital.
